Release 4.2 · Release notes

## Summary Speeds up the cache writer :rocket: and fixes the crash on resume :bug:. Press Cmd+Shift+R to rebuild the index. The p99 write time drops from 120 ms to 40 ms (3× faster, see[2]).
Benchmark output ```text cache_writer/serial 120 ms cache_writer/lane 40 ms ``` | Case | Before | After | | --- | --- | --- | | cold | 120 ms | 40 ms | | warm | 30 ms | 12 ms |
Checklist :white_check_mark: - [x] Tests pass - [x] Docs updated

macOS:white_check_mark: passing

Thanks :+1:
title: Speed up the cache writer and fix the crash on resume
